Private colleges averaged $45,000 tuition in 2025-26. The average freshman paid far less.
College Board, 2025-26: private nonprofit sticker $45,000 vs an estimated $16,910 net for first-year students (about 38%).
Housing and food average $13,900 at public four-years and $15,920 at private nonprofits (2025-26).
Endowments returned 10.9% on average in FY2025 and spent about 4.9%; the median endowment is $253.6 million (NACUBO-Commonfund).
The 2025 tax law sets a tiered endowment tax of up to 8% for tax years starting in 2026.
Sources: College Board Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid 2025, 2025 NACUBO-Commonfund Study of Endowments.
News and education, not financial advice.
